name: mongolian
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.54 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-08. CAVEATS: Common Voice 25 CER of 1.0% and FLEURS 9.15% are printed as-is but a 1% CER on read speech is implausible for any ASR system; treated as a card figure, not a verified one. Comparison column is Whisper-large-v3 zero-shot under an unspecified decode, and the gains are overwhelmingly language coverage (Mongolian was near-unusable in the base), not a general ASR improvement.

benchmarks.config: Card results table, row FLEURS: CER 9.15 vs column 'Whisper-large-v3 (zero-shot) CER' 34.42. Lower is better; normalized CER.
